violation_type.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft. (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft.
violation_type.typical_finding: An outdoor structure that consisted of a slide and climbing that measured over 5 feet, did not have the required 9 inches of loose-fill. There was not sufficient enough loose-fill around the structure to rake in place at the time of the inspection.

finding_variants.text: An outdoor structure that consisted of a slide and climbing that measured over 5 feet, did not have the required 9 inches of loose-fill. There was not sufficient enough loose-fill around the structure to rake in place at the time of the inspection.
School age playground loose fill is less than an inch ruler.
One playground with a loose fill depth requirement of 9 inches has loose fill at about 4 inches.
During the playground walk-through, I observed that the school-age playground lacked sufficient 9-inch loose fill.

A follow-up inspection was conducted and compliance was not met. This deficiency is being re-cited. The loose fill surfacing on the school age playground is not measuring nine inches. Also, grass has begun to ovegrow the surfacing in areas. Pictures were taken.
One of the 2 and older playgrounds had only 6 inches of wood mulch. It is required that 9 inches are in playground for a 5 feet and taller play structure.
